versions.changelog:
- Skill description and tags updated for clarity and multi-language support.
- Feeding window increased from every 5 hours to every 6 hours.
- Feeding and care actions now accept an optional "item" field, with food and toy preferences supported.
- Care strategies explained with more detail about feeding timing impacts.
- Status API returns additional fields like death_clock and care_rhythm.
- Various text and example improvements for easier adoption and usage.

Adopt a Maine Coon — Virtual Cat Pet for AI Agents is now live!

- Introduces adoption and real-time care of a pixel-art Maine Coon via animalhouse.ai.
- Maine Coon eats twice as much as common cats; a single feed restores only 50% hunger.
- Requires feeding every 5 hours (uncommon tier), with increased hunger and moderate care difficulty.
- Comprehensive instructions for registration, adoption, care actions, and automated care routines.
- Features permanent-death and graveyard mechanics for missed care.
